title: Pre-start chiller 2 before the job
how: Turn on the manual chiller 2 start override (MAN_C2) at least 60 seconds before the job starts, so a second chiller is carrying load when the ramp arrives.

title: Start the job in two stages
how: Ask the scheduler to start the job at about half power for 150 seconds, then go to full power, so the plant can stage chiller 2 in first.
